stem: Right triangle \(ABC\) has its right angle at \(C\). The area of the triangle is 24, and the length of hypotenuse \(\overline{AB}\) is 10. What is the value of \((\sin A)(\cos A)\)?
solution: \(\sin A = \frac{BC}{AB}\) and \(\cos A = \frac{AC}{AB}\), so \((\sin A)(\cos A) = \frac{(BC)(AC)}{AB^{2}}\).
